subject.title: fix(auth): prioritize explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles

question: Should literal and SecretRef `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` values outrank stored auth profiles by default when `auth: "api-key"` is not set?
rationale: Current docs and current-main resolver behavior are profile-first, while this PR changes which credential can be sent for existing configurations; automation cannot choose that compatibility policy safely.

options.title: Keep profile-first default
options.body: Require the branch to preserve stored-profile and explicit profile-id selections by default, using the existing `auth: "api-key"` opt-in for config-first behavior.

options.title: Adopt config-first default
options.body: Approve the compatibility change only after the PR updates all resolver callers, labels, docs, tests, and upgrade proof to match the new order.

options.title: Narrow to status-marker fix
options.body: Pause the precedence change and land only the marker/placeholder status-formatting repair if that is the confirmed bug.

recommendation.title: Keep profile-first default
recommendation.body: Require the branch to preserve stored-profile and explicit profile-id selections by default, using the existing `auth: "api-key"` opt-in for config-first behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal on the touched auth resolver, label, runner, and documentation surfaces.
